:::{#hero-heading}

I'm a third-year PhD student at the [University of Wisconsin–Madison](https://stat.wisc.edu/) working with [Dr. Matthias Katzfuß](https://sites.google.com/view/katzfuss/home). 
My research is focused on finding new methods in spatial statistics, Gaussian processes, and uncertainty quantification, specifically with applications in climate and environmental science. Currently, I am working on state-space models involving non-Gaussian forecasts.

Before starting my PhD, I got a Bachelor's degree from [Brigham Young University](https://statistics.byu.edu/) where I did research with [Dr. Matthew Heaton](https://mheaton.byu.edu/). 
I recently completed a year-round statistics internship at [Sandia National Laboratories](https://www.sandia.gov/) where I worked with [Dr. Katherine Goode](https://goodekat.github.io/).
I'm originally from Lindon, Utah, and my hobbies include watching college sports, camping, hiking, and spending time with my family. 

You can find my [publications](publications.qmd), [talks](presentations.qmd), and [CV](files/CV/JacobJohnsonCV.pdf)
on this site. The best way to reach me is by email at <jajohnsonstats@gmail.com>.

:::
